descripcion: At B2 comparisons use clear comparative and superlative forms plus simple connectors like whereas and on the other hand. The weighted, qualified contrast expected at C1 isn't the target yet — a clear, well-connected comparison is enough.

filas: Both are quite similar in price.
This one is more expensive, whereas that one is cheaper.
I'd prefer the first one, to be honest.

ejemplos.texto: Both options are quite similar in price.
This one is faster, whereas that one is more reliable.
On the other hand, the second option takes longer.

notas: Whereas is a clean, neutral way to introduce a contrast without sounding too formal or too casual.
On the other hand works well to start a new sentence that contrasts with the previous one.
A comparison feels more balanced if you mention at least one similarity before the differences.

es.en: Spanish comparatives transfer directly (más… que – more… than). Whereas has no single-word Spanish equivalent, so Spanish speakers tend to use while, which is fine, or leave the contrast unmarked.
es.es: Los comparativos españoles se transfieren directamente («más… que» – «more… than»). «Whereas» no tiene un equivalente español de una sola palabra, por lo que los hispanohablantes suelen usar «while», que es válido, o dejan el contraste sin marcar.

de.en: German wohingegen corresponds exactly to whereas, and während covers both while and whereas. Contrasting therefore transfers directly.
de.de: «Wohingegen» entspricht genau «whereas», und «während» kann sowohl «while» als auch «whereas» bedeuten. Kontraste lassen sich daher direkt übertragen.

it.en: Italian mentre covers both while and whereas, so the contrast word is familiar. Invece is a useful bridge for on the other hand.
it.it: «Mentre» copre sia «while» sia «whereas», quindi la parola di contrasto è familiare. «Invece» è un buon ponte verso «on the other hand».

fr.en: French alors que and tandis que correspond exactly to whereas, so contrasting transfers directly.
fr.fr: «Alors que» et «tandis que» correspondent exactement à «whereas» ; le contraste se transfère donc directement.

pt.en: Portuguese ao passo que corresponds exactly to whereas, and enquanto covers both while and whereas. Contrasting therefore transfers directly.
pt.pt: «Ao passo que» corresponde exatamente a «whereas», e «enquanto» pode corresponder tanto a «while» quanto a «whereas». O contraste, portanto, se transfere diretamente.

errores: Comparing only the differences without mentioning any similarity.
Using more + adjective with short adjectives that take -er: more fast instead of faster.
Overusing but instead of trying whereas or on the other hand.

autochequeo: Have I mentioned at least one similarity as well as differences?
Are the comparative forms correct (faster, more expensive)?
Have I used whereas or on the other hand at least once?
Is the comparison connected with whereas or a similar linking word?
promptCorreccion: Focus only on how the comparison is made: comparatives, whereas, similarities and differences. Check whether at least one similarity is mentioned before the contrast, and whether the preference is clearly stated. Do not rewrite the text.

es: «*mientras que*» rendered as *meanwhile* instead of *whereas* or *while*.
de: *während* rendered as *during*: *During Bern is small, Zurich is big* instead of *While Bern is small…*.
fr: «*tandis que*» rendered as *meanwhile* instead of *whereas* or *while*.
